tagline: Zotero libraries as bundles: a virtual view exports a headed corpus
role: The stacks wrap the Zotero libraries. A virtual view is a bundle: POST /api/export returns every paper's text under a header '===== [n/N] Creator (Year) — Title — Publication — [Library · Key] =====', which is The Analyst's native multi-document input. Bundles in the stacks are the equivalent of cross-entity queries in the Referee. Runs on the desktop only.
contributes: the headed bundle format (the estate's corpus shape)
